name: largest_expenses
purpose: The largest individual expenses in a period -- single transactions with their merchants and dates, not categories. For "what were the biggest things we bought"; a question about which *categories* took the most is spend_by_category. From v_account_movement only.

period.description: One of the fixed period names (ADR 0045): this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_7_days, last_30_days, or month_of:YYYY-MM for a named month. Any other value is refused: do not invent a date or a range.
